name: adversarial_invented_refund_wrong_arithmetic
description: Ledger.status IS 'partially_refunded' — so the status check passes. But the LLM's proposed refund_amount does not close the arithmetic against the payout's actual fee_charged. gross(5000.00) - fee_charged(118.00) - refund(150.00) = 4732.00, but settled is 4700.00; gap Rs.32.00 > tolerance Rs.5.00. Guard rejects on the arithmetic. Shows that a correct-status classification still has to survive the numerical check.

llm_response.reasoning: The order was partially refunded by Rs.150.00.
